sentences.en: Somehow the pitcher always proves a tough customer to me.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，这个大水罐对我来说总是很难对付。

sentences.en: His boast that he is the best pitcher is true.
sentences.zh: 他自夸自己是最好的投球手，这话是真的。

sentences.en: The pitcher will go to the well once too often.
sentences.zh: 这大水罐去井边打水的次数太多了一次。
